statement: Every unit-speed geodesic is simply closed with period 2D. For each p ∈ M, the map v 7→ expp(Dv) from SpM onto the cut locus is a smooth sphere fibration whose fibers are great spheres of one dimension k, independent of p. Its differential has nullity k. The model is determined as follows: (i) If k = n − 1, the model is a sphere; if k = 0, it is a real projective space. In these two cases the metric classification is known: the manifold is isometric to its equally scaled model. (ii) If 0 < k < n − 1, the manifold is simply connected and its integral cohomology ring has one generator of degree k + 1. The possibilities are complex-projective type, quaternionic- projective type, and Cayley-plane type, with the dimensions listed below.
